reviews.text:
My dog ​​was very well treated. The whole team is attentive. They respond to messages and send videos of the animal.

The place is very clean.

I recommend it.

Dear Josias,

Thank you for your feedback.

Dear Luiz Carlos,

Thank you for your feedback.

Dear Vanessa,

Thank you for your feedback.

With each photo and post from Animaleme, I feel even more eager to visit this special place! 🐾❤️
Those who love their pets know how important it is to find professionals who care for them with affection, respect, and dedication. I have two Shih Tzus who are part of my family, and I always look for a place where they are welcomed with love and attention.

I hope to soon take my little ones to visit the clinic and receive all the care you demonstrate. Congratulations on the beautiful work and for making a difference in the lives of animals and their families! 🐶✨
With love, Rosane
I've had complete confidence in them for over 20 years.

My elderly cat was hospitalized and needed surgery. He was very well treated and returned home healthy. I received daily updates on how he spent his nights in the hospital. I recommend the clinic and would like to thank the entire team for the care and attention they gave my cat!

The service itself is very good. But my dog ​​had cancer, they took a long time to tell me, and when they finally diagnosed him, even though it was terminal, they wanted to intubate him with chemotherapy, which wouldn't solve anything. Really, in this aspect, where money speaks louder than words, I felt the clinic fell short.

Dear Raquel,

Thank you for your feedback.

I took my only daughter, Joice, and we received excellent care. They were efficient and caring with her, and everything went well; she was discharged yesterday. I highly recommend Animaleme! Big hug to the doctors and all the staff! Joice sends kisses.

Our dog has been cared for by the professionals at Animaleme since we bought her. We moved to a different neighborhood, but we insist on continuing her care there.
However, today the Animaleme team went too far after already providing their service with their usual excellence, and then I brought up a problem. I needed a specific brand of vaccine that the clinic doesn't carry. In other words, it was my problem, not the team's problem to solve.
Well, this same team picked up the phones and didn't rest until they found a place that offered this brand of vaccine to refer me to.
The girls managed to find it, referred me, and everything went perfectly. Case solved.
But I would like to record here that this supportive, humane, and kind behavior touched me deeply.
Team, I saw and registered in my heart everything you did for us.
God bless you and receive our gratitude.

Dear W. Almeida,

In order to understand what happened, we would need a report in your evaluation; otherwise, we will not associate it with our clinic, which always aims for excellence in service and the well-being of your pet.

Dear Karla,

Thank you for your feedback and recognition of our work.

Dear Tais,

Thank you for your feedback.

I recommend it for your pet!
Everything works: qualified professionals and humane service, plus the location and space are great!
My puppies are being very well cared for!

It was terrible, and they only ripped me off knowing about my kitten's kidney problem. They delayed the surgery and always found ways to charge me more money!!!! Bunch of mercenaries!!!! I DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE TAKE THEIR PETS THERE!!!!!! IN THE END, I LOST MY BELOVED LITTLE ONE AND GOT ​​SICK AS I AM UNTIL NOW BECAUSE OF THESE INCOMPETENT PEOPLE. I don't agree with their response; I paid everything they charged!!! And about the bypass, I spoke with several veterinarians, and they informed me that the stone would pass with the medication that was given, and the second stone that was already in the bladder could have been removed with a simple surgery to unblock the duct, and my kitten would be alive today! You are incredibly incompetent!!!! EVEN WITHOUT GREAT FINANCIAL MEANS, I PAID YOU EVERYTHING!!!! And you wanted my kitten to stay longer so you could keep charging this indecent daily fee!!!! Hypocrites!!!
Thank you Jessica for your feedback. You can always count on us.

It was my first appointment at the clinic, but I received excellent care, from the reception staff to the doctor. I had a small problem with my four-legged daughter, I called and they answered immediately. Dr. Letícia gave me her utmost attention; I felt very secure with her approach, and she didn't fail to support me when I needed it most. Thank you all.
Very good, my baby, very well cared for 😍🐈! 🙏 …
Wonderful service and highly qualified professionals!

This clinic is terrible. My dog ​​was extremely ill for months. One month, he received antibiotics, had tests and a CT scan, and we believed he would be okay. The following month, he got even worse. Another round of tests and CT scans, and suddenly he had a life-threatening problem that hadn't been detected the previous month. After expensive emergency surgery, weeks later, at home, I was covered in bites, and so was he. After visiting the hospital, they confirmed that my dog ​​had brought mites from a clearly VERY unsanitary clinic. We both needed treatment for mange, which lasted for weeks. I had to leave my apartment several times for pest control while struggling to care for my dog. After a month, the bites worsened, and I became extremely ill. I was rushed to the emergency room, where I was diagnosed with Brazilian spotted fever, a deadly disease. I was treated and narrowly escaped death. Unfortunately, my dog ​​wasn't so lucky and, after 16 wonderful years, passed away weeks later due to the terrible treatment he received at this clinic. I spent a HUGE amount of money on awful service and ended up in the hospital, spending even more money, and I was never reimbursed! Save yourself some money and find another clinic!

I'm used to traveling abroad with my dogs all the time, I know the prices for a travel health certificate, I've never paid more than R$200 in Copacabana, this clinic had the audacity to ask me for R$1380. Luckily I didn't waste my time going there, but it's worth sharing so that no one else wastes their time either. Maybe they thought they were talking to a layperson.
Dear Armando, Thank you for your feedback. It's recognition of the good work we do.

The ad says the clinic is open 24 hours. But I need to know the cost of a consultation. My dog ​​is sick, I've called the number in the ad several times and they hang up. On WhatsApp they say they don't respond via WhatsApp. In other words, they don't answer at all! It's outrageous!
They're sensational!

Dear Fernanda,
Thank you for your feedback. We will pass it on to the veterinarians mentioned.

You can always count on the entire Animaleme team.
Excellent

Excellent clinic, well-trained professionals, top-notch service, very clear information, and every day during the cat's hospitalization the clinic sends videos and updates on her condition and recovery. I found it excellent and I recommend it.

The service is always excellent!!! I had one of my dogs neutered there last week, and from the pre-neutering exams to the post-operative follow-up, I received total support not only from the veterinarians but from all the other professionals at the clinic. I couldn't have chosen a better place to take care of my little ones.
Thank you for your feedback.
I took my dog ​​in at dawn and they attended to her immediately! They were very attentive, sending updates on her condition twice a day. I highly recommend them!

Terrible service. I waited over 40 minutes and the girl couldn't tell me how much longer it would take. She said it wouldn't be long, but it took much longer than expected. I had a scheduled appointment, but she was unwilling to give me a more specific time. My dogs got nervous, and I had to leave. It was a very bad experience. I don't recommend this place.

Although I've received good service on a few occasions, I had a terrible experience with my chihuahua, who was medicated by them and had an allergic reaction that could have been fatal. The clinic didn't take responsibility, charged an additional 370 reais, and when I questioned them, I heard shouting from the receptionist and two veterinarians who treated me with pure cynicism. In the images you can see the difference in the swelling. I arrived with one problem and left with two, not to mention the neglect, rudeness, and stress. I do not recommend them.

We received excellent service, Bacon and Paçoca were calm and treated with care by the staff!

We highly recommend them 🐾🐾

My dog ​​Nala was hit by a car. When I arrived at AnimaLeme, she was promptly attended to ♥️🙏🏻 Everyone was very careful and attentive to Nala and our family! She needed to be hospitalized, and the team always kept us informed! Our experience was very positive! I am so grateful for the attention and care they showed us! Nala is recovering well at home 🙏🏻

Clinic with outrageous prices!
There was an accident involving my dog ​​and another dog that passed by her on a narrow street in Copacabana, and unfortunately my dog ​​hurt her ear, nothing too serious. I offered to pay for the accident. The owner took her to Animaleme because it was the closest. When the bill came, I almost fell over! It was R$970!!!! They take advantage of being the only nearby emergency clinic! I know several more reputable clinics than yours that would have charged half the price. It's absurd! Luckily, the owner was very kind and split the cost with me.

SINCE I CANNOT DIRECTLY RESPOND TO THE CLINIC'S ANSWER, I AM INCLUDING IT IN THE FIRST COMMENT:

I understand that the dog that was bitten may have been a patient of the clinic for years — but I, personally, am not and, honestly, I cannot afford to be. And even if I could, I wouldn't be, because I consider the prices very abusive. And I'm not the only one with this perception—many people comment on it. The truth is, many times, people go to the clinic because it's the only nearby option at the moment and because of the urgency of the treatment.

At no point did I question the quality of the team's care. My criticism was exclusively regarding the price charged, which I consider very high. I knew it would be expensive, but I was taken by surprise—the final amount was shocking.

It wasn't me who chose to take Lulu to the clinic; her owner did. However, since it was my dog ​​who bit her and caused the injury, I felt obligated to cover the costs—which I consider the right thing to do. But even so, I was very surprised by the price charged.

It was an accident, of course, but the cost of the treatment left me quite shaken. The treatment involved a suture with local anesthesia, the consultation, and medication. I know well-regarded clinics that, even if considered expensive, probably wouldn't charge that amount.

That's my position, with all due respect.

I think this clinic is a source of pride for our neighborhood. Everyone is always very friendly, especially Dr. Leticia, who took care of my kitten with great attention and was always very helpful. I've always taken my kittens to Dr. Pedro, even when it was at the other address, and I loved being seen by Dr. Leticia this time; she's excellent. Thank you all so much for taking such good care of my son and for the great service!
Excellent service, they saved my best friend. I recommend them!

5 stars!

I, Yuumi the cat, had the most incredible experience with Dr. Pedro! The professionals are super attentive, patient, and competent. They perfectly understood my needs (and my human's!) and provided personalized and effective solutions.

Communication was clear and transparent, and I always felt informed and secure. The service was of high quality, and I can say that I am absolutely satisfied!

If you are looking for an exceptional experience, don't hesitate to choose Animaleme! They are the best!

Highly recommend!
My cat Pretinho received excellent care from the emergency room to his hospitalization at the clinic. I was very pleased and highly recommend it. It's a bit pricey, but it's worth it!

Animaleme Clinic is very special.
They've saved my dog ​​twice already.
I can't thank them enough.

Attentive and caring professionals. I received excellent care from Dr. Palloma and the entire team present on September 17th and 18th. Congratulations and thank you for the care given to Sebastiana!!!
The service with Dr. Isabela was excellent, she was very attentive, and my pet is much better since his last appointment two days ago. I recommend her!
Julieta and I received excellent care at the clinic. Special mention goes to Dr. Palloma Vitorino, who was incredibly attentive at all times, which was essential for Julieta's improved health.

Unfortunately, we had a terrible experience at the clinic.
We scheduled an appointment to have our dog's stitches removed, and when we made the appointment, we mentioned that she was aggressive and restless. Upon …

Dear Carolina,
We were unable to identify your registration by name. … More
Super attentive and professional team!!! ❤️
I loved it! Everyone is very attentive. I was desperate, my pet was hospitalized, and I always received a response in real time. Thank you all so much!

We received excellent care! My Zaion, an American Bully pocket dog 🐕🐶, was treated in the emergency room for emergency exploratory abdominal surgery performed by Dr. Pedro and his entire team. He was hospitalized, received a transfusion, and is now recovering at home. He was treated with so much love and care 💓💓💓 …
10 out of 10. Excellent professionals taking great care of my Mel.
